abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single Shared Expenses configuration is allowed.

add_expense.name: Add expense
add_expense.description: Add an expense to a group. Called from the interface it obeys the group's rules, like the panel does; called from an automation there is no account behind it, so it goes through and the history records "Someone".

group_id.name: Group
group_id.description: The id of the group, as it appears in the panel's address.

amount.name: Amount
amount.description: In whole money, not in cents. 85.42, not 8542.

paid_by_member_id.name: Paid by
paid_by_member_id.description: The id of the member who paid.

expense_date.name: Date
expense_date.description: When it happened. Left out, now.

currency.name: Currency
currency.description: ISO 4217 code of what was handed over. Left out, the group's own. The day's rate is fetched and frozen onto the expense.

category_id.name: Category
category_id.description: The id of the category to file it under.

settle_up.name: Settle up
settle_up.description: Record that one member paid another back.

group_id.name: Group
group_id.description: The id of the group, as it appears in the panel's address.

from_member_id.name: From
from_member_id.description: Whoever is out of pocket, the one whose money left.

to_member_id.name: To
to_member_id.description: The id of the member who was paid back.

amount.name: Amount
amount.description: In whole money, not in cents.

payment_date.name: Date
payment_date.description: When it happened. Left out, now.

currency.name: Currency
currency.description: ISO 4217 code of what was handed over. Left out, the group's own.

description.name: Description
description.description: A note saying what it was about.
